evidence.summary: The bounded protocol and existing task/channel vocabulary express deterministic admission and lifecycle decisions.
Real task scheduling and concurrent execution remain external.

reproduction.instructions: run the current service native suite and inspect the host resident driver boundary

summary: Task and channel state-machine semantics remain usable for bounded decisions, but the resident service still relies on a host driver for real scheduling and concurrent runtime execution.

workaround.description: Host resident loop and scheduler remain the runtime realization.
